description:
FOUND (s526w1, HTTP-Message t/message.t row 101: decoded_content of a "Content-Encoding: quoted-printable" body is undef, perl "foo").
Probe (scratch p-qp.pl): `use MIME::QuotedPrint; print decode_qp("fo=6F")` -- perl "foo", PCL dies "Undefined subroutine &MIME::QuotedPrint::decode_qp called".
In perl, encode_qp / decode_qp are XS functions in Base64.xs; core MIME/QuotedPrint.pm is only `*encode = \&encode_qp` etc. over them.  FIX SHAPE: add encode_qp($str [, $eol [, $binmode]]) and decode_qp($str) to lib/MIME/Base64.pm in Perl (RFC 2045 rules as Base64.xs implements them: soft line breaks at 76, trailing whitespace before a newline encoded, `=XX` hex, "=\n" removal in decode; MIME::QuotedPrint's own t/quoted-print.t is the oracle), plus a must-win lib/MIME/QuotedPrint.pm if the core copy does not load.  Rows: 1 on the board today (message.t 101).  Layer: lib/ shim.
subject: MIME::QuotedPrint is not usable: perl core MIME/QuotedPrint.pm imports encode_qp / decode_qp from MIME::Base64 XS, and lib/MIME/Base64.pm (the shim) does not define them -- "Undefined subroutine &MIME::QuotedPrint::decode_qp"
